purpose: Independent classical-MD check (MEAM) of the GB10's MACE melting point and latent heat.
status: DROPPED: failed the alpha-Ga stability check (metals/Ga/stability/RESULT.md): the relaxed 0 K cell is off by -8.4% (b) and +6.6% (c) and the next neighbour shell collapses toward the close pair (2.70/2.74 -> 2.62/2.68 A; ~1.9 neighbours within 2.6 A at 303 K instead of 1); the pair itself survives. This potential's alpha-Ga is a distorted structure, so its melting point would not be gallium's.
engine: LAMMPS (needs the MEAM package: check `lmp -h | grep -i meam` on the Nebius image)

potential.citation: E.C. Do, Y.-H. Shin, and B.-J. Lee (2009), "Atomistic modeling of III-V nitrides: modified embedded-atom method interatomic potentials for GaN, InN and Ga1-xInxN", J. Phys.: Condens. Matter 21(32), 325801.
potential.pair_coeff: pair_coeff * * potential/library.meam Ga In potential/GaIn.meam Ga
caveats: The Ga parameters come from a Ga-In(-N) alloy fit. NIST warns that elemental potentials taken from alloy descriptions may not work well for the pure species; validate before trusting.
alpha-Ga is a covalent-dimer (Cmce) metal; 2NN MEAM fitted with an fcc reference may not reproduce its structure. Check the solid stays alpha-Ga during the solid NPT stage.
No NIST potential for pure Ga ships LAMMPS files (Belashchenko 2012 EAM is liquid-only, no files).

structure.source: coolorbit/sim/alloys.py ELEMENT_CRYSTALS (Donohue, The Structures of the Elements, 1974; alpha-Ga: Sharma & Donohue 1962). Starting lattice constants; NPT relaxes them.

melting_point_guess.use: ONLY to place the temperature bracket. Not a reference value: the calibration references live in data/calibration/ (Teammate 1).

latent.protocol: solid vs liquid enthalpy at Tm

analysis.latent: python ../analyze.py latent h_solid_TTM_MEAM_K.dat h_liquid_TTM_MEAM_K.dat --log-solid log_Ga-latent-solid.lammps --log-liquid log_Ga-latent-liquid.lammps

if_bracket_missed: all melting -> shift the bracket down by 20%; all freezing -> up by 20% (same rule as the GB10 Simulator), then refine around the crossover with 4 temperatures 2% apart.
